g.text: Strijder power entry and backup path - conceptual connectivity
VSYS_BACKED is NOT a fixed 12 V rail.
Charging and discharge paths must not
Filter capacitor, charger and supervisor returns also connect
to PWR_RTN; physical current loops require layout design.
Chassis/shields are not assumed power-return conductors.
Warning lamps use separate assessed fused distribution.
Signal arrows are control intent, not controller pin numbers.
Fuse values, voltage limits, pack, ratings and all pin numbers TBD.
